command:
cat <<'SCRIPT' > /tmp/setup_ca.sh
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: install packages =="
sudo -n apk update
sudo -n apk add --no-cache openssl ca-certificates

echo "== STEP 2: create CA directory =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca
cd /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca

echo "== STEP 3: generate CA private key =="
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out ca.key 4096

echo "== STEP 4: generate self-signed CA certificate =="
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key ca.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA" \
  -out ca.crt

echo "== STEP 5: verify generated cert subject =="
sudo -n openssl x509 -in ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates

echo "== STEP 6: install into system trust store =="
sudo -n cp ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-certificates

echo "== STEP 7: verify installed in system bundle =="
grep -c "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/ca-certificates.conf || true
awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /BEGIN CERTIFICATE/{c++} END{print "cert_count_in_bundle="c}' /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
openssl crl2pkcs7 -nocrl -certfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt | openssl pkcs7 -print_certs -noout | grep -A1 "subject=" | grep "OS Comparison Root CA" && echo FOUND_IN_TRUST_STORE

echo "== STEP 8: verify trust works against a cert signed by this CA =="
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out /tmp/leaf.key 2048
sudo -n openssl req -new -key /tmp/leaf.key -subj "/CN=test.oscomparison.local" -out /tmp/leaf.csr
sudo -n openssl x509 -req -in /tmp/leaf.csr -CA ca.crt -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -out /tmp/leaf.crt -days 365 -sha256
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /tmp/leaf.crt

echo "== DONE =="
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/setup_ca.sh
/tmp/setup_ca.sh
